This feels great. I clicked "Edit details" on the CSS Grid card, and the title and description were already filled in with what had been gathered, so I just changed the title to "CSS Grid reference" and saved — I didn't have to retype the parts that were already fine. Editing right there inside the card, with the existing values sitting ready to tweak, is exactly the experience I wanted for fixing up an auto-grabbed title that isn't quite right.

Since this is really about managing a saved card, two closely related things come to mind:

- Once in a while I'll paste a link wrong, or the address changes. So alongside the title and description, I'd want to be able to correct the web address on a bookmark too, not just those two text fields.
- And I need a way to get rid of a bookmark entirely — something I saved by mistake or just don't want anymore. So a way to delete a bookmark outright should live in here somewhere.

The inline title/description editing you've shown is spot on; could we round out this managing step with fixing the address and deleting a bookmark?
